title: StitchRAG: Constructing Compact and Evidence-Preserving Contexts for RAG with Diffusion-Based Stitching
abstract: arXiv:2611.22766v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) improves factuality by grounding large language models (LLMs) in external evidence. However, long retrieved contexts incur computational overhead and can even hurt performance due to noisy or irrelevant content. We propose \textsc{StitchRAG}, a framework for constructing compact context in RAG. \textsc{StitchRAG} builds a faithful, information-dense context while dynamically compressing the retrieved passages. We adapt the size reduction ratio to each passage by formulating a utility maximization trading-off the retained information and computation costs. We then extract answer candidates and query-related keywords from passages as anchors and collect passage sentences containing anchors under the derived size constraint. Finally, we connect or stitch the collected sentences together using text diffusion to form a coherent and natural context. Experiments on five open-domain QA benchmarks show that

translated_title: StitchRAG：通过基于扩散的拼接为RAG构建紧凑且保留证据的上下文
translated_abstract: 检索增强生成（RAG）通过将大型语言模型（LLM）锚定于外部证据来提升事实性。然而，冗长的检索上下文会带来计算开销，甚至可能因噪声或无关内容而损害性能。我们提出了StitchRAG，一个用于在RAG中构建紧凑上下文的框架。StitchRAG在动态压缩检索段落的同时，构建忠实且信息密集的上下文。我们通过效用最大化的方式权衡保留信息与计算成本，为每个段落自适应地确定压缩比例。随后，我们从段落中提取答案候选和与查询相关的关键词作为锚点，并在所得的尺寸约束下收集包含锚点的段落句子。最后，我们利用文本扩散技术将收集到的句子连接或拼接起来，形成连贯且自然的上下文。在五个开放域问答基准上的实验表明……
tldr: StitchRAG提出了一种RAG框架，通过效用最大化自适应压缩检索段落，提取含锚点的句子并利用文本扩散技术将其拼接成连贯、紧凑且保留证据的上下文，在降低计算开销的同时提升事实性。
en_tdlr: StitchRAG is a RAG framework that adaptively compresses retrieved passages via utility maximization, extracts anchor-containing sentences, and stitches them into a coherent, compact, evidence-preserving context using text diffusion, reducing computational overhead while improving factuality.
